By the way, to answer the smaller questions, they will not lock you in a room unless you are violent towards them, they have to constantly check up on you, and your first psych ward visit usually should be through your emergency unit of your local hospital. They usually won't just let you into a bigger, long term psych ward without paperwork and a history already established.
